about.title: Who I Am
about.subtitle: A brief story about the person behind the code
about.p1: I'm Mani, a 20-year-old backend developer based in Mashhad, Iran. My journey into software started two years ago with frontend development — but I quickly discovered where my real passion lives: behind the scenes, where data flows, requests find their paths, and APIs quietly power everything.
about.p2: Today, I build with Node.js and Express daily. NestJS shaped how I think about architecture — modular, clean, and scalable. PostgreSQL and MongoDB are the tools I reach for instinctively. When I encounter something I don't know, I don't pretend — I sit with the problem until it's solved.
about.p3: I'm not looking for just a job. I'm looking for a team where I can invest my energy and get energy back. Where code reviews are conversations, not corrections. Where shipping matters, but so does how you ship.
about.philosophy: Code should be written for the next person who reads it — and that person might be you, six months from now. I believe in clean architecture not because it's trendy, but because it makes systems survivable. Every abstraction should earn its existence.
about.approach: I break complex systems into small, testable pieces. I read documentation before searching Stack Overflow. I write tests for the critical paths. And I never ship something I can't explain to a junior developer.
about.aspirations: System design, distributed architecture, and building platforms that serve millions — that's the trajectory. I'm deepening my knowledge in domain-driven design and microservices, with the long-term goal of becoming a senior backend architect.

ridex.name: RideX
ridex.description: A full-stack ride-hailing platform with AI at its core — serving passengers, drivers, businesses, and admins through dedicated panels. Features intelligent route optimization, dynamic pricing, and real-time tracking.
ridex.architecture: Next.js frontend with modular panel architecture, Node.js/Express API layer, MongoDB for data persistence, Redis for caching and real-time state, integrated AI services for route optimization and matching.
features: AI-powered route optimization and driver matching
Dynamic pricing engine based on demand and traffic

vendora.name: Vendora
vendora.description: A production-ready multi-vendor e-commerce backend built with NestJS. Designed for platforms requiring vendor support, complex product attributes, and flexible payment flows — inspired by systems like Digikala.
vendora.architecture: NestJS with modular architecture, TypeORM for database operations, PostgreSQL for relational data, Redis for caching and session management, JWT-based authentication with RBAC.

marketplace.name: MarketPlace Shop
marketplace.description: An online marketplace backend implementing core e-commerce functionality including product listings, user management, and order processing with a focus on clean API design.
marketplace.architecture: Node.js with Express, MongoDB for data persistence, JWT authentication, RESTful API design patterns.

axishr.name: AxisHR
axishr.description: A comprehensive Human Resources management system built as a backend-only service. Handles employee lifecycle management, leave requests, attendance tracking, payroll calculations, and organizational structure.
axishr.architecture: Node.js with Express and TypeScript, MongoDB for flexible document-based data models, JWT authentication with role-based permissions, RESTful API following clean architecture principles.
